notes: The page continues the preceding question and then states a Conjecture fondamentale with two conditions claimed equivalent: geometric origin of the homomorphism and an anabelian centralizer condition on the indicated restriction. The heading is underlined but its colon is not. The hypothesis has a layered addition V séparé before the still-plural réguliers; the crossed upper séparés remains doubtful and is not regularized from the live singular. U une modèle is revised to variété, Alors to Considérons, and tout hom to raised un hom. The script-E notation is used in all four extension-group positions. All three connecting shafts (B_V-B_U, the f equation, and V-U) are headless. Every live hom abbreviation and the crossed hom are dotless, as is inserted ext; isom also lacks the stop H supplied. The marginal note begins underlined NB pr l’instant, concerns V itself as an elementary anabelian model, and ends with clear disons followed by an uncertain dim. 1. group. Its compressed bornera/surtout phrase remains marked, and no number or punctuation in the final group is silently resolved. The literal terms anabélienne/anabélien and homomorphisme are kept; H’s admissible and shorter morphisme are not supported. There is no exclamation mark after déterminé. The universal-looking sign in b has both a V-like crossed course and an A-like returning outline, so ∀ is first with A retained as a graphical alternative; it is not expanded to tout. The small raised rings on the E_V terms are retained as C’s circles; H’s typographic o is not treated as a distinct readable glyph change. Retracing in homomorphisme and the final script E does not reveal a separate earlier word or symbol, so none is invented. No author page number is visible. Thin foliation 47 stays in the margin. The source has running text, inline equations, underlining, cancellations, and insertion leaders, but no drawing or diagram. No mathematical verification was performed. The original-coordinate audit boxes cover all additions, cancellations, the whole marginal note and uncertain dimension numeral, complete doubtful b paragraph, all π_1 indices and final 1, foliation, and different-word disputes.
